title: Legacy Giant Says Farewell: Jeff Dean Announces Departure from Google to Co-Found DiscoLoop AI with Old Friends

content_html:
After 27 years in the technology industry, the legendary figure in the AI field, Jeff Dean, has officially announced his departure from Google. In his internal farewell letter, he reflected on this amazing journey, witnessing the company grow from an initial team of 25 people into a large enterprise with over 190,000 employees, and developing as many as 13 products with user bases exceeding one billion.

After leaving Google, Jeff Dean did not stop. He will join several old friends and senior colleagues, Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le, to embark on a new entrepreneurial journey, co-founding a new company called DiscoLoop AI.

As one of the key figures in the history of artificial intelligence, Jeff Dean's recent departure and collective entrepreneurship have attracted widespread attention in the industry. It is generally believed that this also reflects a new trend in which top AI research talents are gradually shifting from traditional tech giants to independent innovation teams.

content_html_zh:
在科技行业摸爬滚打27年后，人工智能领域的传奇人物杰夫·迪恩（Jeff Dean）正式宣布离开谷歌。 在他的内部告别信中，他回顾了这段奇妙的历程，见证了公司从最初的25人团队成长为拥有超过19万名员工的大型企业，并开发了多达13种用户数量超过10亿的产品。

离开谷歌后，杰夫·迪恩并没有停下脚步。 他将与几位老朋友和资深同事 Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals 和 Quoc Le 一起踏上新的创业之旅，共同创立一家名为 DiscoLoop AI 的新公司。

作为人工智能史上的关键人物之一，杰夫·迪恩近期的离职和集体创业引起了业界的广泛关注。 普遍认为，这也反映出人工智能顶尖研究人才逐渐从传统科技巨头向自主创新团队转移的新趋势。
